wikipediaSummary.title: Raw Power
wikipediaSummary.description: 1973 studio album by Iggy and the Stooges
wikipediaSummary.extract: Raw Power is the third studio album by American rock band the Stooges, released on February 7, 1973, by Columbia Records. The album departed from the "groove-ridden, feel-based songs" of the band's first two records in favor of a more anthemic hard rock approach inspired by new guitarist James Williamson, who co-wrote the album's eight songs with singer Iggy Pop.
